purpose: Strengthen attribution and turn maintenance advice into bounded, executable evidence; do not expand to LLM task accuracy.

arms: before plus only upstream fallback block and serializer
after minus only fallback block and serializer
causal_intervention.boundary: Actual local MCP stdio, native Agent and actual loopback provider HTTP request
causal_intervention.comparison: For each fixed input compare the entire follow-up request: before+patch versus after, and after-patch versus before. A switch in the structured-only arm is sufficient/necessary only within this fixed environment and these fixtures.
causal_intervention.nonhistorical_arms: Patch-only and reverted arms are experimental interventions, not released versions.

guidance_matrix.boundary: Native Agno tool message or native Hermes handler output; no stronger transport claim for this matrix
guidance_matrix.oracle: Declared exact text facts or recursively decoded JSON subsets with type-sensitive values; private application metadata must be absent. Empty-object check distinguishes explicit {} from missing data. Conflicting-channel retention is not conflict resolution or answer correctness.
guidance_matrix.cost: UTF-8 output bytes and duplicate answer occurrences only; not model token cost, latency or model harm.
guidance_matrix.validation: Oracle negative controls for wrong keys, bool/int coercion, string/number coercion, missing object and private metadata leakage; positive controls for wrapper changes and key reordering.
guidance_matrix.scope: Authored diagnostic stress cases, not independent incidents, random samples or an effectiveness benchmark. No aggregate pass-rate ranking across different recipient boundaries.

guidance_policy: Each recommendation must name supporting observations, the boundary, a concrete regression input/assertion, and conditions under which the recommendation is inappropriate. New synthetic edge cases are not labeled newly confirmed production defects.
